listing.name: Titus the Fox / FoxRV
listing.summary: 🦊 A new engine for Titus the Fox: To Marrakech and Back (DOS, 1992), in C + SDL3. Original levels and rules, 🖥️ 16:9 widescreen, 🎮 gamepads, 🎵 AdLib music (Nuked-OPL3) or PC speaker. Runs on Windows, Linux, Nintendo 3DS/2DS and 📱 Android (Winlator, GameNative, GameHub). Bring your own copy of the game.
